outputs: normalized subtitles, metadata or temporary authorized audio

explicitly authorized non-YouTube audio normalization is needed

tools.trigger_when: authorized non-YouTube audio has no usable subtitles and both audio fallback gates are true
authorized whisper.cpp audio fallback is enabled
RSS/Atom/sitemap parsing or provenance validation is needed

boundaries: Only public HTTP(S) sources; no login, cookie, credential, DRM, paywall, CAPTCHA or age-control bypass.
Public YouTube is captions-and-metadata only; audio/video download and Whisper fallback are blocked even when audio fallback is otherwise requested.
Non-YouTube Whisper fallback requires allow_audio_fallback=true, audio_access_authorized=true and a concrete authorization/rights_basis.
The official yt-dlp Unix binary bundles EJS scripts; Node is used locally and remote EJS component downloads are not enabled.
Raw source content is never automatically project truth.
Content is only persisted in artifacts when reuse_allowed=true; otherwise only provenance, metadata and hashes persist.
Audio media and model files are temporary runtime inputs and are never committed to Git.
All output is at most controlled_runtime evidence and remains subject to Webactueel-workflow source quality, rights, deduplication and currentness gates.
